items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 100:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the root point of Rachel? It is known that the roots of the ZON are in the ZAT of the Nekudim. And they have inner vessels and posterior vessels. For the aspect of the KHB HGT of their vessels up to the chest, which came out from the aspect of the looking of the eyes into the AHP, is discerned as inner vessels; and the aspect of the chest and below, which they attained at the time of greatness, by the power of the coupling of the Yesod of AK in the Aba and Ima of the Nekudim, is discerned as posterior vessels. It is also known that the breaking was only in the posterior vessels, because they had already come out to the aspect of BYA, by the Parsa of the second restriction, and were not fit to receive the light of Atzilut, and therefore they broke. This is unlike the vessels from the chest and above, which were in the aspect of Atzilut even from the aspect of the second restriction, and therefore they did not need to break; however, they too broke, and it is because of their joining and mixing with the posterior vessels. Therefore, when those inner vessels of the ZAT were corrected in Atzilut, and were separated from the posterior vessels once, no further matter of diminution and fall operates in them, for had they not mixed with the posterior vessels, they would not have broken even in the Nekudim, and now that they were separated from them, they already remain clean of any blemish, and became the aspect of Atzilut permanently. However, everything that was separated from the posterior vessels of these ZAT is only through the ascent of the MAN from the lower ones, and therefore their degree depends on the lower ones, and if the lower ones corrupt their deeds, they return and fall to BYA.
